# Commission Payout Payment Clause

A manual commission-payout payment facade. It uses the single-instruction payment lifecycle, and the recipient confirms receipt. Amount and instruction bindings default to `/product/totalMinor` and `/payment` through Payment Base. Requests execute inside the instruction, where guarantor acceptance and outcome operations are exposed.

Cancellation/retirement checks unresolved requests and reserved funds. Opening or retiring an enclosing payout is distinct from confirmed money movement; cumulative completion, reversal and pending reservations remain separate instruction facts.

Configuration references: `bindings.amount` defaults to `/product/totalMinor`; `bindings.instruction` defaults to `/payment`.
